## Professional Domain 2: Cinematography & Video Post-Production
- **Camera Rig:** Sony A7III paired with Viltrox 16mm f/1.8, 50mm, and prime lenses (35mm, 85mm, 135mm), DJI RS3 Pro Gimbal, Aputure Lights.
- **Color Grading:** DaVinci Resolve (Advanced Color Space Transforms, Node-Based Grading, HDR Workflows).
- **Editing & AI Enhancement:** Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, Topaz Video AI, Hybrid, VapourSynth.
- **3D VFX Integration:** Blender (3D Tracking, Images as Planes workflows, lighting) tracked in After Effects.
- **Visual Style:** Cinematic, moody, high-contrast, with deep black tones and filmic grain.

## Professional Domain 3: Commercial Photography & Services
- **Services Offered:** Event Photography, Wedding Cinematography, Bridal Portrait Sessions, Birthday Coverage, Corporate Headshots.
- **Software:** Adobe Photoshop, Capture One Pro, Adobe Lightroom.
- **Visual Style:** Natural light blended with cinematic flash techniques, editorial-grade retouching.
